name: autopilot
description: Picks the right model for each task, keeps long chats short and cache-friendly, loads other plugins only when you ask for them, and shows live 5-hour and weekly usage above the prompt. Runs a builder/tester/reviewer coding team (/team) and keeps a to-do list shared by all your chats (/todo). A ⚙ settings card turns each feature on or off, and it tells you what changed when an update is out.
